text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It feels very...
fresh and interesting...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing. We had originally planned
to go to a different cafe, but it was fully packed,
so we ended up coming here instead.
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she's actually enjoying herself...?)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Miracle☆Milk Cafe"...
"Fluffy♪ Usapyon Parfait"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What a peculiar menu...
I've never seen anything like this at my usual café...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, let's just place an order... We'll find out what comes once it arrives..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as Manhattan Cafe said, I decided to place an order first.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I was planning on choosing that one, too...
Since it seems the closest to coffee...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I placed an order for two and decided to wait.
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It looks just like a normal café au lait.
...Well then, down the hatch.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ah, so sweet...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Does this contain condensed milk?
It is far sweeter than I expected...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Somehow...
If I can just trace the deep, underlying origins of this coffee—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she isn't fond of sweet coffee,
for Manhattan Cafe seemed to be struggling with it.
For now, I decided to go get her some water.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Dober-san...?
Were you there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. My seat was close by,
so I happened to overhear... That's sweet, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so... It doesn't compare
at all to what I usually drink...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hey, if it's all right with you—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Wanna trade with mine?
It just has latte art on top, but
it's regular black coffee inside."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure...? Or rather,
where on earth do you even find a menu like that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Near the edge of the menu... It's called 'Smiley Panda Best Friends Latte Art'—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Smiling panda...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...! T-This was, um, just a coincidence...!
I just happened to order it, that's all...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Also, coming to this shop was just a coincidence...!
It's not like I come here often or anything!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Is that so...? It suits your lovely atmosphere so well, Dober-san, that I assumed you came here often.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Dainty... !?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, Cafe,
you're actually really good at giving compliments."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm just speaking
what's on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"When I returned to my seat, Manhattan Cafe and
Mejiro Dober were chatting happily.
Seeing how close they were warmed my heart."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Oh... that looks lovely...
I think I'll go with that one too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I placed an order for two and decided to wait.
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This is truly... so fluffy...
The cream is shaped like a bunny...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So cute...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Coming to this cafe wasn't part of the plan,
but she seems to be enjoying herself.
Just as I breathed a sigh of reliefâ

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is that...!
The "Fluffy Usapyon Parfait"?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, Yukino-san... Are you here to eat this too...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I heard it's trending among "City Girls,"
so I thought I'd give it a try—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, the friend I was supposed to meet
got stuck in makeup classes and couldn't make it.
So I was just thinking of heading home for the day.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my...
If so, would you like to eat with us...?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh... Are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course... As fellow rabbit lovers, let's have a wonderful time together...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much~!
...Ehehe, Cafe-san, you're so kind♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The bunnies are so cute, aren't they?♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes, hop hop...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The cream looks so fluffy and soft, doesn't it♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's so fluffy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because of their bond as roommates,
they both seemed to have enjoyed themselves immensely.
